_about: Parameters of the production-signal simulation. All are SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION unless stated; they set a stylised world, identical for every regime.

mean_demand.source: units per product per month (scale only)

trend_sd.source: SYNTHETIC: yearly log growth/decline of each product's demand

fad_rate.source: SYNTHETIC: chance per product per month of a sudden fashion boom (x2 to x4, fading over months)

mean_life_months.source: SYNTHETIC: average product life ~7 years (plus 12 months minimum)

pilot_share.source: SYNTHETIC: new products start with capacity for 30% of their eventual demand (Article 3d pilot run)

hours_slack.source: SYNTHETIC: total labour hours allow 15% more than base demand (same for all regimes)

max_cap_change.source: SYNTHETIC: capacity of a product can change by at most 15% a month (machines, training)

elasticity.source: SYNTHETIC: market demand falls 1% per 1% price rise

market_response.source: SYNTHETIC: market capacity grows 0.5% per 1% of price above cost

smoothing.source: exponential smoothing weight for UNIRA forecasts

stock_z.source: stock target = 5 x recent absolute forecast error (about 3 weeks of stock); chosen from the sensitivity run (1.5, 3, 5, 8) as the best balance of waiting and waste
